parent_objective: audit bounded source-only closed-loop fixture pilot preflight before any longer pilot or claim escalation
blocked_by: M2488 closed-loop policy-action path smoke must be audited before any longer pilot or claim escalation
source-only pilot evidence must not be mistaken for driver performance or high-fidelity validation
the row artifact must be checked for contract and leak flags before follow-up route selection
supersedes: direct longer source-only pilot without auditing M2488
direct performance claim from M2488 path smoke

public_gates: M2489 must audit M2488 summary and pilot_rollout_rows artifacts
M2489 must verify checkpoint admission obs_dim 72 action_dim 3 actor_encoder and action_sequence_horizon
M2489 must verify three fixtures reset and 60 policy-action rows were produced
M2489 must verify observation action backend status wheel diagnostic and actor-input leak gates
M2489 must distinguish source-only policy-action path smoke from driver performance high-fidelity validation paper evidence and controller ranking
M2489 must not train replay run PPO rank select a winner promote a checkpoint or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not install external simulator dependencies
do not import external high-fidelity simulation packages
do not run external high-fidelity simulation
do not execute new policy actions in the audit milestone
do not change the deployed action contract
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim high-fidelity validation readiness
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim driver performance from path-smoke rows

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits bounded same-contract policy-action source-only fixture pilot evidence before follow-up route selection
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-only closed-loop policy-action result audit only; no new policy action, external simulation, measured validation, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, or validation verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2488 checkpoint admission is incomplete or invalid
stop if M2488 row counts observation/action gates or leak flags fail
stop if M2488 is interpreted as driver performance or validation
stop if follow-up route would skip audit or claim escalation boundaries
fallback_plan: route to pilot implementation repair if row or contract artifacts fail
route to actor-source inventory if checkpoint admission is invalid
route to bounded longer pilot execution only if M2488 is accepted with correct scope
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2488 produced first source-only same-contract policy-action path smoke evidence

training_stage.stage_objective: source-only closed-loop fixture pilot result audit
blocked_shortcuts: no external simulator installation or import
no new policy action in the audit milestone
allowed_updates: M2489 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2488 summary and rows are checked
supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2489 audits a source-only policy-action preflight and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2489; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2488 20-step source-only fixture pilot rows only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If audit rejects M2488, record the negative result and route to repair rather than weakening self-ID or validation gates.
allowed_claims: source-only same-contract policy-action path smoke audit
no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits new bounded closed-loop policy-action source-only fixture data
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: does not decide paper verdict but checks the first policy-action path-smoke evidence after HF0 scaffolding
must_synthesize_if: M2488 audit rejects the closed-loop path smoke
the next task is another audit or design-only milestone
source-only pilot rows are mistaken for performance or validation

hypothesis: Auditing M2488 can determine whether the source-only closed-loop policy-action path smoke is accepted and choose a bounded follow-up without overstating evidence.
success_criteria: audit checks M2488 summary and pilot_rollout_rows
audit verifies checkpoint admission and 60 row policy-action coverage
audit verifies observation action and actor-input leak gates
audit registers a bounded follow-up milestone
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution new policy action training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2489 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2489 changes actor input or action contract
M2489 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2489 executes new policy action or rollout
M2489 treats source-only path smoke as driver performance
M2489 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2489 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2489 passes if it audits M2488 source-only policy-action path-smoke evidence and registers a bounded follow-up without new policy actions, external simulation, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
